findings.detail: Replaced the trend drawing with a numerical LinePlot, gradient fill, markers and bounded guides; repaired humidity typography and separate number/unit Labels.
Bundled font faces approximate the generated glyphs. Fine image grain, lighting and stroke rendering are not pixel-identical.

scope: Native design prototype at 406 × 776 logical pixels, captured at 2× in desktop Studio. No claim of exact generated-font identity, responsive phone layout, live feeds or complete app navigation.
user_design_preference: not reviewed by user in this QA receipt

runtime_regression.basis: Personally compared all seven current source/native pairs. Native numerical charts retain source trends, selected points, area shading, legends and axes; typography, cards, controls and the original botanical crop remain consistent. Approximate curve sampling, small font rasterization differences and flatter source gradients/paper grain remain accepted prototype limitations documented in the individual findings.
